description: This file contains automated tests for verifying the functionality of pressing keys in input elements within a web page using Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: should work
methods.description: Tests pressing a key in an input element and verifies the input value updates accordingly.

methods.name: should not select existing value
methods.description: Tests pressing a key when the input has an existing value, ensuring the new character prepends correctly.

methods.name: should reset selection when not focused
methods.description: Ensures that the selection in an input resets when focus shifts away before pressing a key.

methods.name: should not modify selection when focused
methods.description: Verifies that focused input with a selection retains its selection after pressing a key.

methods.name: should work with number input
methods.description: Tests pressing a key in a number input and verifies the input value updates correctly.
